english.title: Use a vehicle with obligatory lighting equipment not fitted
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not fitted with **(..SPECIFY OBLIGATORY LAMP(S)/REFLECTOR(S)/REAR MARKING(S)/DEVICE(S)..) of a type specified in regulation 18(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 18(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
